description: Remove the acknowledgement of a host or service problem, so it notifies again. Says whose acknowledgement it was, and for a host how many of its services stay acknowledged. Waits until the engine shows it.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Empty: the host's acknowledgement.

with_services.description: For a host: also remove the acknowledgements of its services, which otherwise stay.

name: remove_acknowledgement
title: Remove Acknowledgement
